fields.name: title
fields.title: Card title
fields.description: Card face name shown in the 3-card level-up draw.

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Card id
fields.description: Unique card id (stat id or SPECIAL_CARDS id, e.g. "damage" or "doomblaster").

fields.name: description
fields.title: Description
fields.description: Card body text describing what the pick grants (e.g. "+200% damage & explosive shots (slower fire)").

fields.name: rarity
fields.title: Rarity
fields.description: Draw-weight tier. The four SPECIAL power cards are always epic; stat cards read STAT_RARITY. Source player_stats.gd card_rarity().

fields.name: weight
fields.title: Roll weight
fields.description: How many copies of this card go into the weighted draw pool. Source player_stats.gd RARITY_WEIGHT: common 4 / rare 2 / epic 1.

fields.name: grants
fields.title: Grants
fields.description: What picking this card awards — one or more stat-point allocations and/or rune-stack grants. A plain stat card has one stat grant; El Granados grants a Damage AND a Magnetic stat point.

fields.name: kind
fields.title: Grant kind
fields.description: Whether this grant allocates a player stat point or stacks a combat-side rune/perk.

fields.name: stat
fields.title: Stat granted
fields.description: The player stat this grant allocates a point into (when kind = stat).

fields.name: rune
fields.title: Rune granted
fields.description: The rune/perk this grant stacks (when kind = rune).
